description: Structured location records extracted from a narrative turn. Creates catalog entries in the adventure's location registry for future retrieval.

fields.locations: array of new locations introduced this turn. Each entry: { name (string — canonical place name), description (string — one sentence) }. Only genuinely new named locations — not locations listed in Known Locations.
fields.reasoning: string — one short sentence explaining the extraction choice, for audit.

notes: Only emit locations that are genuinely new named places introduced in this narrative turn.
Do NOT re-emit locations listed in the Known Locations section — they already exist in the registry.
Generic references ('a hallway', 'the road') are not locations — skip them.
If no new locations were introduced, return { locations: [], reasoning: '...' }.
